# encryptdecrypt.org - LLM & AI Crawler Tools Directory
# Free, 100% Client-Side Developer Cryptography, Encoding & Utility Tools

- [Base64 Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/base64-encode-decode/): Encode or decode strings and binary files to Base64 format instantly.
- [URL Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/url-encode-decode/): Percent-encode or decode URL query strings and URI components safely.
- [HTML Entities Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/html-encode-decode/): Convert special characters to HTML entities and back to prevent XSS.
- [Base32 Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/base32-encode-decode/): Encode and decode RFC 4648 Base32 strings and authenticator keys.
- [Base16 Hex Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/base16-hex-encode-decode/): Convert ASCII/UTF-8 text into hexadecimal byte values and reverse.
- [Base58 Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/base58-encode-decode/): Bitcoin and IPFS standard Base58 string encoder and decoder tool.
- [Base85 (Ascii85) Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/base85-ascii85-encode/): Adobe PostScript and Git binary diff standard Base85 converter.
- [URL-Safe Base64 Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/url-safe-base64/): Base64 encoding replacing + and / with - and _ without padding.
- [UTF-8 Bytes Encoder/Decoder](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/utf8-encode-decode/): Inspect UTF-8 byte representation, code units, and Unicode points.
- [Binary to Text Translator](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/binary-translator/): Convert 8-bit binary 0s and 1s to human-readable text and ASCII.
- [Morse Code Translator](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/morse-code-translator/): Convert international Morse code dots and dashes to text audio-ready.
- [Punycode IDN Converter](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/punycode-converter/): Convert international domain names with Unicode characters to Punycode.
- [UUEncode / UUDecode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/uuencode-uudecode/): Legacy Unix-to-Unix historical encoding format encoder and decoder.
- [Quoted-Printable Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/quoted-printable/): MIME email format quoted-printable transfer encoding decoder.
- [Base64 to Image Data URI](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/base64-to-image/): Convert raw Base64 data strings into visual images and preview inline.
- [Image to Base64 Converter](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/image-to-base64/): Generate data:image/png;base64 URI strings from any uploaded file.
- [Base91 Encode/Decode](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/base91-encode-decode/): High-density binary-to-ASCII Base91 byte packer algorithm.
- [Percent Encoding Decoder](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/percent-encoding-decoder/): Strict RFC 3986 percent-encoding and component parsing tool.
- [Hex to Binary Converter](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/hex-to-binary/): Translate hex digits directly to raw 4-bit nibble binary streams.
- [Binary to Hex Converter](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/binary-to-hex/): Group binary 8-bit bytes into clean hexadecimal string values.
- [Octal to Text String](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/octal-to-text/): Convert 3-digit octal byte representations back into plain ASCII.
- [Decimal to Binary & Hex](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/decimal-to-binary-hex/): Convert arbitrary base 10 integers into binary, octal, and hex.
- [ROT47 Cipher & Encoder](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encoding-decoding/rot47-cipher/): Rotate all 94 printable ASCII characters by 47 positions.
- [AES 256 Encrypt & Decrypt](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/aes-encrypt-decrypt/): Military-grade AES-GCM and AES-CBC symmetric encryption in browser.
- [RSA Keypair & Encryption](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/rsa-encrypt-decrypt/): Generate 2048/4096-bit RSA keys and encrypt messages with public key.
- [ChaCha20-Poly1305 Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/chacha20-poly1305/): High-speed authenticated stream cipher encryption per RFC 8439.
- [Triple DES (3DES) Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/triple-des-3des/): Legacy Triple Data Encryption Standard cipher encoder and tester.
- [Blowfish Cipher Tool](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/blowfish-encrypt/): Bruce Schneier symmetric 64-bit block cipher encryptor.
- [Twofish 256-bit Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/twofish-cipher/): AES finalist Twofish symmetric encryption implementation.
- [RC4 Stream Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/rc4-stream-cipher/): Rivest Cipher 4 variable key-size stream cipher generator.
- [Caesar Cipher Decoder](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/caesar-cipher-decoder/): Classic Roman shift cipher solver with automatic shift brute-force.
- [Vigenère Cipher Solver](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/vigenere-cipher-solver/): Polyalphabetic substitution cipher encryption and cryptanalysis tool.
- [ROT13 Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/rot13-cipher/): Standard 13-character Caesar alphabet rotation cipher for spoilers.
- [Atbash Hebrew Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/atbash-cipher/): Hebrew alphabet reversal substitution cipher encoder and decoder.
- [Affine Mathematical Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/affine-cipher/): Monoalphabetic substitution using linear congruence (ax + b) mod 26.
- [Rail Fence Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/rail-fence-cipher/): Zig-zag transposition cipher encryptor with variable rails.
- [Playfair Digraph Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/playfair-cipher/): Historic 5x5 key matrix polygraphic substitution cipher.
- [Simple Substitution Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/substitution-cipher/): Custom alphabet mapping substitution cipher generator and solver.
- [Polybius Square Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/polybius-square/): Fractionating grid cipher converting letters to 2-digit coordinates.
- [Baconian Steganography Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/baconian-cipher/): Sir Francis Bacon 5-character binary steganography encoder.
- [XOR Stream Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/xor-cipher/): Bitwise XOR binary key encryption and stream masking utility.
- [Hill Matrix Cipher 2x2 / 3x3](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/hill-cipher/): Lester Hill linear algebra matrix modular arithmetic cipher.
- [Enigma Machine Simulator](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/enigma-machine-simulator/): WWII Wehrmacht M3/M4 Enigma cryptographic rotor machine emulator.
- [Bifid Delastelle Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/bifid-cipher/): Fractionation plus transposition polygraphic cipher.
- [Beaufort Reciprocal Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/beaufort-cipher/): Variant of Vigenère cipher where ciphertext = key - plaintext.

- [Columnar Transposition Cipher](https://encryptdecrypt.org/tools/encryption-ciphers/columnar-transposition/): Rearrange message characters into tabular key columns.
